newsitem.title: USA: Travelmax sues ex-holders, alleges fraud.
newsitem.headline: Travelmax sues ex-holders, alleges fraud.

text.p: TravelMax International Inc said Monday it has filed a lawsuit against some of its former shareholders and operators alleging breach of fiduciary duty and fraud.

The suit, filed in Superior Court of Orange Country, seeks damages "in excess of $13 million," plus special and punitive damages, TravelMax, a marketer and distributor of travel-related products and services, said.
TravelMax said the suit also alleges that the defendants misused funds and failed to repay debt.
The defendants could not be immediately reached for comment.
